g.id: Why Buying From Private Sellers Can Be Risky?
Private sellers may seem honest and the car may look great, but hidden mechanical issues or past accident damage can easily go unnoticed without expert inspection.
Buying a car from a private seller can save money, but it also comes with serious risks.
